answer: Tidebreaker Protocol After each transaction batch, compute the variance in message timing across identities within a session window. A sudden spike in synchronized timestamps—aligned to within 1ms across many agents—triggers a ripple audit. This audit samples historical interaction patterns and flags clusters showing identical behavioral fingerprints. Each flagged identity is then subjected to a sable verification: its past actions are re-scored using a weighted entropy model derived from communication latency, request frequency, and response diversity.
